segments.he: אָמַרהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ טוֹב תָּמִיד [גָּאט אִיז תָּמִיד גוּט]:
segments.en: (9.) He said: "Hashem Yisburach is always good" [in Yiddish: "Got iz tomid gut"].
